scene: let p=PALETTE,t=0;function render(){let w=W(),h=H(),cx=w/2,cy=h/2;ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);t+=0.008;for(let i=0;i<24;i++){let a=i*(Math.PI/12)+t*0.2;let r=Math.min(w,h)*0.35+Math.sin(t*2+i)*15;let x=cx+Math.cos(a)*r,y=cy+Math.sin(a)*r;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(x,y);ctx.strokeStyle=p[i%3];ctx.globalAlpha=0.08+0.05*Math.sin(t+i);ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();}for(let j=0;j<30;j++){let a=j*0.21+t*0.1;let d=(j*25+t*30)%(Math.min(w,h)*0.45)+80;let x=cx+Math.cos(a)*d,y=cy+Math.sin(a)*d;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,2.5,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=p[j%3];ctx.globalAlpha=0.3+0.2*Math.sin(t*3+j);ctx.fill();}requestAnimationFrame(render);}render();
